data.one_liner: Dart library implementing the Yin pitch detection algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Detects pitch from audio samples. Supports both float (List<double>) and int (UInt8List) PCM buffers. Returns pitch, probability and a flag indicating detection.
use_when: You need to extract pitch from recorded audio samples.
You are building an audio analysis or music app that requires pitch detection.
You have PCM audio data in either float or int format.
avoid_when: You need continuous real‑time pitch tracking with low latency.
You require a high‑performance native implementation for large audio streams.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies.
Supports both float and int PCM buffers.
weaknesses: No support for real‑time streaming or live audio capture.
Limited performance benchmarks; may not be suitable for high‑volume audio processing.
